'''Elios Maliss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial soldier|Sith trooper]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Elios was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] where he encountered the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] who was on a search for a [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] that caused havoc across [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He informed Kallig that the ghost was situated in the Jedi Enclave and has a connection to a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Ashara Zavros]]. He aided Kallig in finding holocron recordings of Ashara to determine her weaknesses, before meeting with her and convincing her to summon the ghost of her ancestor, [[Kalatosh Zavros]]. But upon summoning the ghost, Elios revealed himself, having betrayed Kallig to [[Darth Thanaton]], who made him a Lord in exchange for the ghost. However, he did not live long enough to enjoy his new title, as Kallig killed him for his treachery.
